about: Benchmark configurations of FastAFD on GB200 NVL72 that fit in 8 nodes (4 GPUs each). Each entry names the runner script, its environment, the workload rows (prompt_pools.json) and the reference result measured with this code; reference.step_ms (or period_ms) is the target and tolerance the relative band for PASS. kind: decode (standard decoding), spec (EAGLE-3 speculative decoding, acceptance fixed at 1.8 tokens per step), cad (core-attention disaggregation), variant (MoE backend, microbatch count, overlap or memory ratio changed from the decode configuration).
